propositions: Provider qualifiers are currently decided by regex shape matching (pre-colon prefix identifier-like), which accepts typos and may break on future model ids containing colons or dotted prefixes
The shape test at _PROVIDER_QUALIFIER_RE (config.py:192) and its application in split_provider_qualifier (line 203) must be replaced with explicit membership testing against a known provider registry
A static frozenset KNOWN_PROVIDER_NAMES of 24 canonical pydantic-ai provider names must be introduced in config.py, and membership must be tested instead of shape
Explicitly configured providers must validate membership and raise LLMConfigError with valid names listed, while unknown inline prefixes must be treated as unqualified without raising
Slashed provider names (gateway/anthropic, etc.) currently rejected by shape regex must be accepted as valid members
Test assertions pinning 'test' and 'google_genai' as valid providers must be updated, as neither is registered in the actual pydantic-ai runtime
